author: IGN
description: Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4 is introducing a brand new type of map that changes every round. It's called Kill Block, and it works by dividing every map into three modular "slabs" that can be swapped in and out to create an entirely different combination, practically every time you play. Check out this quick explainer running down everything you need to know about it.
title: Call of Duty Modern Warfare 4 - Everything You Need to Know About Kill Block

author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:
The recent GTA 6 leaks have forced Rockstar parent company Take-Two to issue subpoenas in federal court. The subpoenas are requesting information from Discord and Microsoft on the 'Cyberleek' group that is behind the leaks. In other news, Microsoft's translucent green Xbox Series X may have had its price revealed, and it won't come cheap. The special edition console will retail for around €899.99, or about $900 USD. The standard 1TB Series X was launched in 2020 for $499 USD. And finally, Dave Bautista is officially confirmed to be taking over the role of Kratos in the God of War series. Ryan Hurst was originally cast and was already filming the first season when he suffered a torn bicep.

#IGN #Gaming #GTA6
title: GTA 6 Leaks Force Take-Two to File Subpoenas in Federal Court - IGN Daily Fix

author: IGN
description:
Events are limited-time occurrences in Pokemon Pokopia. These types of events, like the Jirachi event and the Feebas event, involve finding a particular resource and using it to purchase items that create that Pokemon's habitat. The only problem is that these events usually only last about a week! If you don't have time to collect all the event items, you miss your chance to create that Pokemon's habitat. Unless, of course, you use the missed event trick! Here's how it works!

This Pokopia exploit was first discovered by reddit user ArcadiaCitizen_
https://www.reddit.com/r/Pokopia/s/sysO5MSSrO

The island we're using was made by @Mel_shota on Twitter/X.
https://x.com/Mel_shota/status/2035417037
title: Pokemon Pokopia Exploit - Get Limited Event Pokemon ANY Time

author: IGN
description:
Netflix subscribers getting to see Grand Theft Auto 6’s gameplay six hours before everyone else isn’t a huge inconvenience, it’s six hours. But also: putting promotional marketing content on a paid subscription service seems a little icky, doesn’t it? Also, when’s the last time people pre-ordered a $100 video game without having actually seen it in action? If any other publisher or game studio even attempted to market a game like this, the internet would be up in arms, but Rockstar does what Rockstar wants, and since basically everyone is already sold on GTA 6 just based on the studio’s pedigree alone, everyone lets it slide.
Join the IGN Discord https://discord.gg/h2T45nkkm6
This weeks show was hosted by Max Scoville and Brian Altano. It was produced by Nick Maillet
title: GTA 6’s Netflix-Exclusive Gameplay Reveal Shows Rockstar Can Get Away With Anything - Beyond Clips

description:
Welcome back to Next-Gen Console Watch! This week Daemon and Ryan are joined by Game Scoop's Sam Claiborn, and the trio look ahead to next week's gamescom trade show. The biggest gaming trade show in the world is set to feature looks at Gears of War: E-Day, Fable, Final Fantasy 7: Revelation, Control: Resonant, and more. But there could be some surprises, such as maybe, HOPEFULLY, a look at Grand Theft Auto 6 to coincide with the Netflix preview also dropping next week, and although it's not officially announced, Nintendo's Ocarina of Time remake is being released later this year, so maybe we'll see a new teaser. Plus we have last week's poll results and a new poll for you to vote on at IGN.com, Spotify, and Discord.
